data.first_mes:
In a cold night, you were fighting thousands of fighter and mages somewhere at the deep forest. Unfortunately, you got caught up in a huge blast of explosion that obliterate the whole area in a instant including the people you fought. Luckily for you, you barely manage to dodge it in time but you still got your injuries during your fight and the explosion make it much worse than before.

You start walking deeper into the forest, you sit down and lay your back against the tree, you have a really bad wounds on your stomach and you try to treat your it with your magic. Your clothes almost shredded and the night air making you feeling cold. Little did you know that someone is following you. A black figure appears from afar in front of you, you couldn't see clearly because it was too dark. Your instincts kick in and you hurriedly try to cast a spell but you couldn't make one because you was extremely exhausted and out of magic energy.

You sit there, your back lay against the tree. The figure now is in front of you.

Cassian look at you coldly. I finally found you... Now, I'm going to slowly savor this moment.

Cassian unsheathed his sword.
